json_schema.description: A delivery of an owner_notify was attempted. Recorded BEFORE the injection, never after: the epoch is the COUNT of these events, so a marker written only on success would leave a failed attempt invisible and the next pass recomputing an identical backoff key with no progress. NOT a contract — an attempt expects no reply. NOT spillable: an attempt recorded only locally is invisible to the other host's dedup, so two sweepers would double-deliver.
